features.text: BREATHFIT FABRIC: Combines breathable compression and flexibility for daily comfort.
ADJUSTABLE ROM HINGES: Allow personalized flexion and extension limits to match your rehabilitation plan.
LIGHTWEIGHT WRAPAROUND DESIGN: Easy to apply, with adjustable straps that ensure a non-slip fit.
UNIVERSAL LEFT/RIGHT FIT: Works interchangeably on either leg for convenience and value.
RELIABLE STABILITY: Supports ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL injuries, meniscus issues, and mild osteoarthritis.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL injuries or sprains
